source_evidence: CMakeLists.txt selects static multithreaded CRT for C and C++ in all configurations and retains PE base relocations. recovery/environment/recipe.py preserves runtime switches in measured product and seed-donor recipes. recovery/tests/test_compiler_environment.py checks actual compiler predefines with contrary-runtime failure controls and freshly links Release, comparing the selected allocator code, reference targets and base relocations with the pinned archive member. This incorporates the compiler/build-policy correction only: full dependency selection, runtime data ownership and application acceptance remain separate obligations under ledger-crt-dependency-verification.
